hero.title: Genealogical Research and Family History
hero.subtitle: Get guidance to research your family history, locate documents, and gather information about your ancestors.

about.title: What is genealogical research?
about.description: Genealogical research is the process of investigating historical documents and records to reconstruct a family's history and understand the origins of their ancestors.
about.additionalInfo: Based on the information available, the research may involve locating civil, religious, historical, and other records that can help identify family relationships, places of origin, and different generations.

important.title: Important
important.text: Each research project is unique. The availability of documents and information may vary depending on the historical period, country, region, and existing sources.

research.title: What can we research?
research.subtitle: Research can cover different types of historical records and sources, depending on the information available and the objectives of each case.

items.title: Birth records
items.description: Locating certificates and records that can help identify dates, places, and family connections.

items.title: Marriage records
items.description: Researching marriage records to identify family relationships and information about ancestors.

items.title: Death records
items.description: Locating death records and information that may contribute to reconstructing family history.

items.title: Religious records
items.description: Researching baptism, marriage, and other records maintained by religious institutions.

items.title: Origin and residence
items.description: Investigating places of birth, residence, migration, and other information related to the family's history.

items.title: Family history
items.description: Gathering and organizing information from different sources to help reconstruct family history and relationships.

cta.title: Ready to start your family history research?
cta.subtitle: Get guidance researching records and information that can help reconstruct your family history.
